lines.en: After calling Yuki, I wind up getting talked into visiting her at her apartment so she doesn't have to venture elsewhere just to head off to work later.
lines.zh: 给 Yuki 打过电话后,我被她说动,去她的公寓找她——省得她为了之后上班,专门往外跑一趟。

lines.en: And while I'm not too keen on the idea of exerting any sort of energy either now that everything hurts all the time, I go to her regardless because it's either that or just standing here.
lines.zh: 虽然如今一切都无时无刻不在疼痛,我也不太想耗费任何力气,但我还是去了她那里——因为除此之外,就只剩站在原地。

lines.en: When I make it to her part of town, I'm reminded of how good I have it to own a piece of real estate in what most would call a nicer area.
lines.zh: 到了她那一片,我想起自己能在大多数人眼中的好地段拥有一处房产,运气有多好。

lines.en: But it's strange to me that this feels more like a home than that does.
lines.zh: 可奇怪的是,这里给我的「家」的感觉,比那里更浓。

lines.en: Perhaps it's just because of what's happening there right now. Or what has happened in the past.
lines.zh: 也许是因为那边此刻正在发生的事。或者过去发生过的事。

lines.en: But whatever it is, I'm glad to be here.
lines.zh: 但无论是什么,我很高兴来到这里。

lines.en: As glad as I can be, of course. Which still isn't that great, all things considered.
lines.zh: 是我力所能及的高兴,当然。综合考量,这也算不上多高兴。

lines.en: But Yuki manages to alleviate some of that pain by making fun of me and poking at my inadequacies in a way that would be sure to make me smile if my facial muscles hadn't all rotted by now.
lines.zh: 但 Yuki 成功消解了那份痛——她取笑我,戳我的短处,那方式本该把我逗笑,可惜我的面部肌肉早已全部烂掉。

lines.en: I do the same and poke fun at her while joining her on the couch.
lines.zh: 我也以其人之道还治其身,一边坐上她旁边的沙发,一边取笑她。

lines.en: I can smell smoke lingering on her breath each time I try to move closer just to immediately remember decisions I've made in the past and second guess myself.
lines.zh: 每次我试图凑近一点,都能闻到她呼吸间残留的烟味,随即想起自己过去做过的决定,重新怀疑起自己。

lines.en: I wonder what would happen if I knew how to say no to myself. I wonder if she'd let me.
lines.zh: 我不知道,如果我学会了对自己说「不」,会发生什么。我不知道她会不会允许。

lines.en: I wonder what I'm doing here.
lines.zh: 我不知道我在这里干什么。
Yuki 的好感度提升到了 [yuki_love]!
